Frequently asked questions

Which regulations do these courses follow?
  • OSHA Incident Investigation Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1960.29 and 29 CFR 1904.39.
  • OSHA 300 Recordkeeping and Reporting Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1904.
  • OSHA Job Hazard Analysis Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations, General Duty Clause (Section 5(a)(1)).
  • OSHA Process Safety Management Training: in accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.119.
  • Stop Work Authority Training: in accordance with the Federal OSHA General Duty Clause and Section 11(c) of the OSH Act.
  • CAL/OSHA Incident Investigation: Train-the-Trainer Mastery: in accordance with Cal/OSHA Regulations 8 CCR Section 3203.
How long does Safety Program Training take?
  • OSHA Incident Investigation Training: 1 hour.
  • OSHA 300 Recordkeeping and Reporting Training: 2 hours.
  • OSHA Job Hazard Analysis Training: 1 hour.
  • OSHA Process Safety Management Training: 2 hours.
  • Stop Work Authority Training: 2 hours.
  • CAL/OSHA Incident Investigation: Train-the-Trainer Mastery: 8 hours.

Training is self-paced, so you can stop and pick up where you left off at any time.

How long do I have to finish?

You get a 3-month completion timeline, 1-year access to training materials.

Do I get a certificate?

Yes. You can download your certificate of completion as soon as you pass the final exam.

  • OSHA Incident Investigation Training: valid 12 months
  • OSHA 300 Recordkeeping and Reporting Training: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Job Hazard Analysis Training: valid 36 months
  • OSHA Process Safety Management Training: valid 36 months
  • Stop Work Authority Training: valid 36 months
  • CAL/OSHA Incident Investigation: Train-the-Trainer Mastery: valid 24 months
Can I take the training on my phone?

Yes. The training is 100% online and works on phones, tablets and computers, 24 hours a day.

Can I buy training for my whole team?

Yes. Enter the number of seats at checkout. Team pricing starts at 2 seats and goes up to 10% off for 501–1,000 seats. For larger orders or invoicing, call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

Is the training available in Spanish?

These courses are available in English and Spanish:

  • OSHA Incident Investigation Training
  • OSHA 300 Recordkeeping and Reporting Training
  • OSHA Job Hazard Analysis Training
  • OSHA Process Safety Management Training

The others are in English.

How do I start my course after I pay?

Right after checkout you'll get an email with your receipt and your login for the learning portal. Sign in at hazwoper-osha.com to begin.

Who provides the training?

Courses are delivered by HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC on its online learning portal at hazwoper-osha.com. Questions? Call 1‑866‑429‑6742.

What is the refund policy?

See the refund policy on hazwoper-osha.com, or call us before you start a course.
